# Documentation instructions

This is a tool-specific adapter. Canonical authority remains repository `AGENTS.md`, `docs/AGENTS.md`, the documentation crosswalk, and the owning current contract.

When editing docs:

- update the canonical owner of a HARD/CONTROLLED rule before copying summaries elsewhere;
- do not turn historical benchmark/release text into current authority;
- search for contradictory current guidance when changing architecture, testing, security, provenance, branch, or agent policy;
- keep AGENTS/adapters operational and concise rather than duplicating architecture manuals;
- when semantics change, update the guarantee inventory and executable proof coherently;
- do not rewrite historical evidence merely to make current implementation look consistent.
